answer.justification: Every logit-level measurement is exactly at its identity value: top-1 and sequence agreement are 1.000, KL, TV and Token-DiFR gap are 0.000, and raw-score shift ÷ TV is undefined (0 ÷ 0). Quantized has KL of at least 0.039 and top-1 agreement of at most 0.955. Fine-tuned and system-prompted shift even more. None of them gives exact zeros, so the unknown model is the reference itself. Output and activation levels were not measured, but the logit level alone is decisive.
